# Inscription Transliteration

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InscriptionTransliteration`](gmeow-InscriptionTransliteration.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InscriptionTransliteration>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

A transliteration of an inscription into another script — an [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) that maps sign sequences from one writing system to another, producing a [`LexicalForm`](gmeow-LexicalForm.md). Standpoint-scoped: competing transliteration schemes (e.g. Hepburn vs Kunrei-shiki) coexist without a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InscriptionTransliteration`](gmeow-InscriptionTransliteration.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
